tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsam yas rab byung grwa tshang par phur 'chams la skyon 'don gnang ba// dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas dang / lha sde mi sde yongs la rgyal tshab rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho 'gro ba'i mgon po gangs can bsod nams dpal bzang pos nyams gso dbu 'don rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i phyag rjes bzang po 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar bskrun pa gnang rjes dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyi dus chen gro bzhin zla nang phur sgrub 'dzugs gnang skabs 'don cha dbyangs rol 'chams tshang ma rang lugs rgya rtse gur pa grwa tshang nas bzhes gnang bzhin lcags byi ba do gal gnang 'dug kyang lo de'i snron zla'i mjug sa skya pa kun blo rang rigs zung bcas 'byor thog spro ba chen pos grwa tshang nas phur sgrub thog 'chams gzigs mdzad byung bas/ sa chog gnang nyin phyogs bzhir gsol gdab bgegs skrod stangs stabs srung 'khor/ phur 'dzugs tsam mdzad/ de'i sang sta gon gyi nyin nas dngos gzhi tshugs thog sa chog grwas bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams rgyas pa/ tshogs 'chams kyang de gsham la 'thud pa zhig gnang song bas lugs 'di 'dra sngags kyi sgrub dkyil sa chog can gang na'ang bshad med pas/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ cho ga cung zad nyams pa la'ang / /cho ga chags pa ma gsung na/ /cho ga phal cher nyams pa la/ /cho ga chags pa 'gyur re kan/ /des na 'chad pa'i gnas skabs su/ /cung zad nor pa gyur yang sla/ /cho ga nor pa gyur pa la/ /grub pa nam yang med par gsungs/ /zhes dang / cho ga 'khrul na las mi chags/ /the tshom za na nyes pa skye/ /des na cho ga ci byed kyang / /shin tu dag par bya dgos so/ /zhes dang / gal te gdod nas med pa'i chos/ /glo bur byas pa ni/ kun gyis rang bzor go ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas pa'am mu stegs byed/

/su la 'dug kyang dor bya yin/ /nged la'ang de ltar 'dug na ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhad gad gyis/ /gal te rgyal po'i khrims yod na/ /chad pas bcad pa'i 'os yin no/ /nor la zog 'tshong byas pa la/ /rgyal po'i khrims la thugs gyur na/ /chos log rdzun mas sbyar ba la/ /rgyal po'i khrims la cis mi thug /ces dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhin bsgrubs na/ /sangs rgyas bstan la phan par sems/ /zhes pa'i lung rjes su blo gzu bor gnas pa rnams 'brang dgos pa ma zad/ rang rang na rang lugs dang mi mthun pa byas na/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir/ 'di skor dag par bsgrub pa ni/ rtsa ba'i gzhung rdo rje las rim las/ sa chog la yang rnam pa bdun/ /sa gzhi blang brtag sbyang ba dang / /byin rlabs sta gon bzung bsrung bya/ /brtags la lto 'phye chu pa'i sra/ /sbyangs la phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ /bzung la blo dang stangs stabs kyis/ /bzung ba rnam gnyis gnyis pa la/ /gsol ba btab dang bgegs bskrad pa'o/ /bskrad pa byin rlabs bka' bsgo dang / /stangs stabs rnam gsum bsrung ba la/ /phur btab bsrung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa 'brel bar/ rang re'i 'chams des snang ba 'gyur thub las/ dpal ldan phur pa mchod pa'i cho ga gang / /rgyas pa'i yan lag sa chog phyag len gyi/ /bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams rim pa ni/ /snang ba 'gyur thub sa lo'i gsung bzhin bris/ /zhes dang / dkyil 'khor blo dman rtogs sla las/ bgegs skrod gsung tshar ba'i rjes su/ stangs stabs dngos ni/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i 'chams dpe snang ba 'gyur thub bzhin rtsa 'chams rdzogs par mdzad rjes/ khro bcu'i stangs stabs dbyangs dang bcas bhan phur thog nas bya'o/ /zhes dang / 'gyur thub las/ me ris sngags kyi bar phyag rgya dbyangs dang bcas pa phyag len bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/

rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal te/ zhes sogs gsung pa yan gyi sa chog yongs rdzogs grub nas/ sta gon ni dkyil chog las/ sta gon la yang rnam pa bzhi/ /thig gdab lha dang bum pa dang / /slob ma sta gon gnas lnga'o/ /thig la'ang ye shes las thig go /lha rnams sta gon gnas pa la/ /lha bskyed mchod bstod snyan gsan dbab/ /slob ma sta gon gnas pa la/ /spro bskyed sdom gzung byin gyi rlabs/ /so shing dri chu chos bshad pa/ /ku sha srung mdud gtor ma btang / /mchod sogs rmi brtag cho ga'o/ /zhes pas sta gon yongs rdzogs bstan/ dngos gzhi la dkyil chog las/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la yang gsum/ /dkyil 'khor bri dang byin gyi rlabs/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin bsgom la lha bskyed dang / /mchod tshogs gtor ma lhag chad bskang / /zhes sogs kyi sdom las gzhan ci yang ma gsungs pas sa chog bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis ka la mi rung ba mngon sum tshad mas grub cing de dang dgra bgegs grub 'tshams sbrel mi rung ba yang dkyil chog las/ rjes chog la yang srung gtor dang / /tshogs dang bsgral mchod lhag ma btang / /bstan skyong phyogs skyong gshegs su gsol/ /phyi nang mchod bstod dngos grub blangs/ /gtor mgron la sogs rten yod rnams/ /brtan zhugs rten med gshegs gsol bya/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus te tshon bskyal zhing / /sbyin sreg bya zhing bdag srung ba/ /lta bas rgyas btab smon lam btab/ /shis pa brjod pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes gsung pas/ dgra bgegs grub 'tshams rjes chog gi skabs su bya ba gsung zhing / sa chog bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams dang sbrel nas bya ba ma gsung 'dug pa'i phyir deng phyin chad sa chog la sngon gtor nas bgegs skrod yan da lta bzhin de nas phyi nang gang rung du gser skyems nas brtsams log 'chams me ri'i 'gros bar byas la/

sgrub khang du hūm̐ chen ka ra'i stangs stabs nas bzung / oṃ badzra ka ba tsi hūm̐ phaṭa bar snang ba 'gyur thub bzhin bya/ 'chams chas bzhag bskang ba bstod pa tshogs gtor 'bul/ ye shes lnga ldan nas bkra shis rdzogs pa'i bar rgyun bskang bzhin te/ sa chog yongs rdzogs grub/ sta gon ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas sgo dbye'i bar yin/ dngos gzhi ni/ tshon gyis 'bri ba nas bdag 'jug rdzogs pa'i bar yin/ rjes kyi gtor bsngo bskang ba bstod pa tshogs bar pa yan bya/ 'chams chas gyon nas rnga 'chams/ slob dpon dang mchod g.yog pas gser skyems/ rig 'dzin bskul/ phur kha bsgyur ba lha srung spyan drangs/ nga rgyal bskyed pa/ dpang gzugs rnams byas nas/ dzaṃ smug dang po rang 'chams dang / srin mo'i rnga brdung yin/ bar pa 'thon pa bar 'jug dang gzigs gdong ma'i bdun brdung yin/ de nas dur khrod bdag po/ rjes ma pu tra'i lam 'gros dang dreg gdong ma'i dgu brdung yin/ grub 'chams dngos la skyang 'gros dgug gzhug tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba/ dzaṃ skyang 'gros/ seng ge'i brjid 'chams/ stag mo'i rngams 'chams/ spyang mo'i 'dur 'chams/ dred mo'i rgyug 'chams rjes 'brel bcas/ dgug gzhug gcig tshe srog ye shes bsgyur ba mi dgos/ rol sil las 'ber blangs sngon 'gro'i gdab tshul gnyis/ gdab kha drug phyi nang gsang ba mag 'chams/ bskang bstod/ lhag ma/ pu tra bskul/ sngon 'gro'i spyi bstabs/ bstan skyong srid zhi dpal 'byor ma/ phyogs skyong gshegs gsol/ dkyil 'khor bskor ba mchod pa nas gtor mgron gshegs gsol bar 'dra/ de nas phur pa gtsug yod na brten pa la brtan bzhugs/ rten dang bum pa'i ye shes pa gtor mgron rten med rnams la gshegs gsol byas nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu/ bdag srung nas bkra shis rdzogs bar yin pas de bzhin bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang kun ldan lcags byi lor bsam yas rab byung pas phur sgrub mdzad pa mthong skabs skyon 'don du sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos pho brang chen po srid zhi dga' tshal gyi yang rtser sbyar ba dge/
